text: Binary per-row: 1 if at least one comment in OC_comments (JSON list of other users' comments, not OP) in a single comment both explicitly quotes a specific OP factual claim (direct quote or close verbatim excerpt of OP title/argument text; title and argument serve as context for identifying factual claims) and argues that same claim is false or wrong; endorsement not required. Quote and refutation must be in the same comment; separate comments don't combine. No match for merely mentioning the topic, quoting opinion/value claims, or quoting without refuting. Ignore view-change/delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and outcome reports in argument or comments (generic delta/platform rule discussion allowed); uses current text including marked edits. Returns 0 for a valid empty comment list or no qualifying comment; null if OC_comments is missing/malformed or title and argument are both missing (but a positive match against available OP text still gives 1).
